# OneWorld integration

This package keeps an exact copy of the Three.js `css3d_periodictable` example
at `UPSTREAM.html`, from Three.js revision
`f9fb68d58e81f3d301ec7f199631a85646c39aca` (MIT).

`index.html` retains the upstream rendering and transformation code. OneWorld
adds Chinese layout labels, keyboard-accessible element cards, and a compact
element detail panel without replacing the original CSS3D implementation.
